rationale: Builds on the current reverse recurrent-tail winner and spends extra export budget where local evidence is strongest: recurrent-tail tensors. The change broadens fp16 keep coverage from q/k-only to q/k/v for every recurrent tail block, targeting post-quantization value-path distortion in the exact int8+zlib score while leaving training dynamics and wallclock behavior essentially unchanged.
title: Recurrent-Tail Value FP16 Rescue
